description.text: Gen Con is a tabletop game convention in the United States. In 2003, as Nintendo and Pokémon USA took the English card game over from Wizards of the Coast, Gen Con in Indianapolis hosted the last Pokémon tournaments Wizards ran, and holofoil Groudon ex and Kyogre ex, the first Nintendo Black Star Promos, were given away there. Later conventions had their own stamped cards: EX Dragon's Bagon for Gen Con 2004 and EX Emerald's Treecko for Gen Con 2006.
